body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a script to build a scheduled Codex-native semantic candidate layer, along with its associated validator results, readback markdown, and unit tests. The review feedback highlights several opportunities to improve the robustness of the implementation by adding defensive guards, optional chaining, and null-safety checks across multiple helper and rendering functions to prevent potential TypeErrors. Additionally, the reviewer suggests adding fail-closed regression test cases to the unit tests to verify behavior when input files are missing or malformed.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
